rationale.en: In the 2012 Official Voter Information Guide the title of Proposition 30 was "Temporary Taxes to Fund Education", and its summary said it increases personal income tax on annual earnings over $250,000 "for seven years". The Legislative Analyst's 2012 analysis says the rates would be in effect for seven years, ending after the 2018 tax year, and describes a substantial projected state budget deficit as background. Context: the stated purpose in the title was funding education; in 2016 voters approved Proposition 55, which extended the higher rates until 2030, as the Analyst notes for Proposition 3.
